subject: Call to dev version of ggplot facet_grid produces unexpected error

messages.author: 519455d3bf64680d
messages.subject: Call to dev version of ggplot facet_grid produces unexpected error
parts:
I am using the git repository version of ggplot and the following error
has arisen. names() shows that Model and Variable are legitimate
variables, but the call to ggplot does not like them. Interestingly, if
I substitute truly invalid variable names (e.g. X and Y) I get a
different error. Suggestions?

Thanks in advance

names(definitive)
[1] "Model" "junk" "Variable" "Value" "altphleb" "b"
[7] "c" "OR" "LCI" "UCI"

> ggplot(definitive)+geom_crossbar(aes(x=Variable, y=OR, ymin=LCI,
ymax=UCI))+facet_grid( Model ~ Variable)
Error: Casting formula contains variables not found in molten data:
Model, Variable

> ggplot(definitive)+geom_crossbar(aes(x=Variable, y=OR, ymin=LCI,
ymax=UCI))+facet_grid( Model ~ X)
Error in `[.data.frame`(plot$data, , setdiff(cond, names(df)), drop =
FALSE) :
undefined columns selected


> sessionInfo()

x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
